examples.vi: Người thợ trèo qua cửa sập trên mái để sửa lại ngói.

senses.vi: lỗ thông; cửa sập

thesaurus.definition: container for coal; shaped to permit pouring the coal onto the fire
an entrance equipped with a hatch; especially a passageway between decks of a ship

vi_block: Sự chạy trốn vội vã; sự ra đi hối hả.
Giỗ rộng miệng (đựng ngô, thóc, hạt... ).
Lỗ, lỗ thông (ở thành tàu, mái nhà, có nắp đậy).

wiktionary.gloss: A container like an open bucket (usually to hold and carry coal).
A broad, shallow basket.
A small hatch or opening in a boat, sometimes one used for draining water from open deck.
A drained trough between the windscreen and bonnet of a motor vehicle, forming the intake to the heating/air-conditioning system, often also containing the windscreen wiper motor.
By extension, the bulkhead at the front of the passenger compartment.
A hatch that provides access to the roof from the interior of a building.
A quick pace; a short run.

blocks.etymology: Borrowed from Middle French escoutille (compare French écoutille), from Old Norse skaut (“corner of a cloth, of a sail”), or alternatively from Spanish escotilla, ultimately from Gothic 𐍃𐌺𐌰𐌿𐍄𐍃 (skauts, “projecting edge, fringe”), from Proto-Germanic *skautaz (“corner; wedge; lap”). Compare German Schoß, Old English sċēat. More at sheet.

senses.definition: To run or move quickly with short, hurried steps.

examples.en: A mouse scuttled across the kitchen floor and hid under the cupboard.
examples.vi: Một con chuột chạy vội qua sàn bếp rồi nấp dưới tủ chạn.

examples.en: The crabs scuttled into the water as soon as we got close.
examples.vi: Lũ cua chạy gấp xuống nước ngay khi chúng tôi đến gần.

senses.vi: chạy vội; chạy gấp

senses.definition: To deliberately cause a plan, agreement, or hope to fail.

examples.en: Rising interest rates could scuttle the property deal.
examples.vi: Lãi suất tăng có thể phá hỏng thương vụ bất động sản này.

examples.en: His rude remarks scuttled his chances of getting the job.
examples.vi: Những nhận xét thô lỗ đã làm tiêu tan cơ hội nhận việc của anh ấy.

senses.vi: phá hỏng; làm tiêu tan; làm đổ vỡ

senses.definition: To sink a ship intentionally by cutting holes into it or opening valves.

examples.en: The crew decided to scuttle the vessel to prevent its capture.
examples.vi: Thủy thủ đoàn quyết định tự đánh đắm con tàu để tránh bị bắt giữ.

senses.vi: làm đắm tàu; đánh đắm tàu

thesaurus.definition: to move about or proceed hurriedly

vi_block: Chạy trốn, chạy gấp, chạy vội.
Làm đắm tàu bằng cách đục thủng (ở đáy, boong hay mạn tàu); làm đắm (tàu) bằng cách mở van cho nước vào.

wiktionary.gloss: To cut a hole or holes through the bottom, deck, or sides of (as of a ship), for any purpose.

examples: The Vichy French fleet in Toulon in 1942 scuttled itself as a final "fuck you" to the invading Germans.
wiktionary.gloss: To deliberately sink one's ship or boat by any means, usually by order of the vessel's commander or owner.
To deliberately wreck one's vehicle (of any sort).

examples: The candidate had scuttled his chances with his unhinged outburst.
wiktionary.gloss: To undermine or thwart oneself or one's position or property, especially deliberately.
To move hastily, to scurry.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English, borrowed from Latin serēnus (“clear, cloudless, untroubled”).

senses.definition: calm, peaceful, and untroubled by worry

examples.en: She had a serene smile on her face.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nở nụ cười thanh thản trên gương mặt.

senses.vi: thanh bình; thanh thản; trầm lặng

thesaurus.definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession

vi_block: Trầm lặng; thanh bình, thanh thản.
Ngài, Đức, Tướng công (tiếng tôn xưng).

examples: She looked at her students with joviality and a serene mentality.
wiktionary.gloss: Calm, peaceful, unruffled.
Without worry or anxiety; unaffected by disturbance.

examples: Her Serene Highness
wiktionary.gloss: Used as part of certain titles, originally to indicate sovereignty or independence.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English, borrowed from Latin serēnus (“clear, cloudless, untroubled”).

wiktionary.gloss: To make serene.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English, borrowed from Latin serēnus (“clear, cloudless, untroubled”).
vi_block: Vùng trời trong xanh, vùng trời quang mây tạnh.

wiktionary.gloss: Serenity; clearness; calmness.
A fine rain from a cloudless sky after sunset.

blocks.etymology: From shogun + -ate (forms nouns denoting rank or office).

thesaurus.definition: a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)

wiktionary.gloss: The office or dignity of a shogun.

blocks.etymology: From or related to Scots skiffle, from skiff (whence English skiff (“light rain, snow, etc”), which see for more). Related to skift (“light dusting of snow”).

thesaurus.definition: a style of popular music in the 1950s; based on American folk music and played on guitars and improvised percussion instruments

vi_block: Nhạc của dàn nhạc đệm ((xem) skiffle-group).

wiktionary.gloss: A type of folk music, with jazz and blues influences, using homemade or improvised instruments.

examples: For quotations using this term, see Citations:skiffle.
wiktionary.gloss: Synonym of skiff (“light shower of rain or snow; light dusting of snow or ice (on ground, water, etc)”).

blocks.etymology: From or related to Scots skiffle, from skiff (whence English skiff (“light rain, snow, etc”), which see for more). Related to skift (“light dusting of snow”).

wiktionary.gloss: To play skiffle.
To move in a way that stirs up and moves anything loose lying on the surface.

blocks.etymology: From take + the + L, in various senses (L as loss or L as elevated).

wiktionary.gloss: To take the loss: to lose a game or competition and to accept that fact; to make a mistake or to otherwise be beset with unfortunate circumstances and recognize the outcome.

examples: We took the L (elevated train) to get downtown last night.
wiktionary.gloss: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see take, L.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- From un- + availability.

thesaurus.definition: the quality of not being available when needed

vi_block: Tính chất không sẵn sàng để dùng; tính chất không dùng được.
Sự không có giá trị (của vé xe... ).

wiktionary.gloss: The state of being unavailable

blocks.etymology: From Middle English unbehealden, equivalent to un- + beholden.

wiktionary.gloss: Not beholden; not obliged or bound by duty or expectations.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-? Proto-Indo-European *(H)n̥dʰí

wiktionary.gloss: Having an insufficient population for economic viability
The removal of a yoke.

blocks.etymology: From wag (“waghalter, rogue”) + -ish.

wiktionary.gloss: witty, jocular, like a wag
mischievous, tricky
Whose sins have been forgiven due to the death of Jesus.
